description: Read, add, replace or remove one of the project's extra pages: tabs such as Story, Lore or Characters, written in Markdown. Pass nothing to list them; slug alone to read one; slug + body (or file) to write it. New pages are team-only; pass public: true to show one to visitors of a public project. Updating a page keeps its visibility unless you pass public.

file.description: Markdown file to use as the body, relative to the project root

slug.description: Short name used in the address, e.g. story

name: inventor_page
